zh.heading: 把说出来的想法，接到手边的工作。
zh.answer: 一呼是面向自有 Agent 网页工作台的 iPhone 语音工具：口述草稿、保存录音笔记、带入文字和资料，也能查看你自己的结构化事项简报。先用下面的示例试试，再判断是否适合你的工作方式。
zh.caption: 你想先解决哪件事？

rows.name: 语音草稿
rows.scope: 在手机转写，校对后交给兼容的网页输入框。
rows.boundary: 准备语音模型、麦克风权限和自己的工作台。发送由你确认。

rows.name: 外设拾音排障
rows.scope: 按输入、播放、试录和切换结果逐步对照。
rows.boundary: 停车后操作；具体可选输入依设备与系统界面而定。

rows.name: 结构化笔记
rows.scope: 保留录音与文字，再选择整理与交接方式。
rows.boundary: 摘要与待办由所选工作台或工具整理，并对照原文确认。

rows.name: 每日跟进简报
rows.scope: 读取你准备的JSON事项，查看来源和下一步。
rows.boundary: 需自有导出或兼容来源，询盘与市场资料由你提供。

faqs.question: 一呼更适合谁？
faqs.answer: 已有 Agent 网页工作台、希望在 iPhone 上少打字接续工作的人。如果只想得到一份录文，独立转录工具可能更省配置。

faqs.question: 现在如何安装？
faqs.answer: 目前提供源码：需要 iOS 18+、Mac、Xcode/XcodeGen、自有签名和可信 HTTPS 工作台；语音模型另行下载。安装步骤在接入指南中。

faqs.question: 网页预览会录我的声音吗？
faqs.answer: 预览使用示例材料，无需麦克风或蓝牙权限。它帮助理解流程；实际录音和工作台体验在 iPhone App 与所选服务中完成。

faqs.question: 草稿什么时候发送？
faqs.answer: 一呼填入文字时不会按下发送。网页工作台仍可能保存或同步草稿，私密材料交接前请了解所选服务的数据设置。

faqs.question: 录音之后就有会议纪要了吗？
faqs.answer: 一呼保存本地录音并分段转写。你可交给所选工作台或工具整理，再对照原文确认人名、数字和待办负责人。

faqs.question: 商机简报从哪里来？
faqs.answer: 来自你现有工作流准备的 JSON 导出或兼容数据源。一呼负责呈现事项，客户数据与询盘资料由你提供。

en.heading: Turn a spoken thought into your next step.
en.answer: Yihu brings voice drafts, local voice notes, sharing and your structured task brief to an iPhone connected to your own Agent web workspace. Try the samples below, then decide whether it fits how you work.
en.caption: What would you like to work on?

rows.name: Voice drafts
rows.scope: Transcribe on your phone, review, then hand off to a compatible web editor.
rows.boundary: Prepare speech models, microphone permission and your own workspace. You choose when to send.

rows.name: Audio input checks
rows.scope: Compare your device, playback, recording and switching results.
rows.boundary: Park before operating. Available inputs depend on your device and system UI.

rows.name: Structured notes
rows.scope: Keep audio and text, then choose how to organize and hand them off.
rows.boundary: Your selected workspace or tool organizes summaries and actions; review against the original.

rows.name: Daily follow-up brief
rows.scope: Read your JSON tasks with their source and next steps.
rows.boundary: Bring your own export or compatible feed, inquiry data and market material.

faqs.question: Who is Yihu for?
faqs.answer: People who already use an Agent web workspace and want to continue by voice on iPhone. If you only need a transcript, a standalone recording tool may be simpler.

faqs.question: Can I install it from the App Store?
faqs.answer: Yihu is currently a source release. Setup requires iOS 18+, a Mac with Xcode and XcodeGen, your own signing and a trusted HTTPS workspace. Speech models are downloaded separately.

faqs.question: Does this preview use my microphone?
faqs.answer: The preview uses sample material and runs without microphone or Bluetooth permission. It illustrates a workflow; the iPhone app and your chosen service provide the actual recording and workspace experience.

faqs.question: When does a draft get sent?
faqs.answer: Yihu inserts reviewed text without pressing Send. Your web workspace may save or sync drafts, so review its data settings before handing over private material.

faqs.question: Will it write finished meeting minutes for me?
faqs.answer: Yihu keeps local audio and segmented transcription. Choose a workspace or tool to organize it, then check names, numbers and action owners against the original.

faqs.question: Where does the sales brief come from?
faqs.answer: You supply a JSON export or compatible feed from your existing workflow. Yihu displays your tasks; it does not supply a customer database or automatically collect inquiries.
